title: Mixed Duo #45
prompt:

#2: Korean, in her early 50s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render.
